title: Etale morphisms of schemes are exactly the locally finitely presented formally etale ones
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence between etaleness and the pair of conditions locally of finite presentation plus formally etale. One direction decomposes etaleness into flatness, unramifiedness and local finite presentation and feeds these into the earlier characterisation; the other direction is the substantive implication, where formal etaleness plus local finite presentation must be converted into etaleness by a reduction to the algebra statement about formally etale ring maps. The reduction to the algebra statement is what the converse turns on. Retained author proof at lines 1716-1742.
